name: scientific-research-plugin
description: Research pipeline skills for OR / ML+OR / supply-chain researchers: survey, fetch, read, plot, polish, verify references, review, rebut, present.

plugins.name: scientific-research-plugin
plugins.description: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 16 skills + 2 subagents take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk, poster, and social note cards — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, note-driven PDF category highlighting, publication-grade figures, top-journal-style section drafting, LaTeX polishing, noun-term jargon auditing, defensive-writing (over-hedging) auditing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, point-by-point rebuttal, venue-transfer resubmission, and Xiaohongshu (RedBook) multi-image note cards with optional auto-publish. Its prior-art survey covers research-grade questions across engineering and academic sources, not just papers.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向运筹学与机器学习的全流程科研流水线：16 个技能 + 2 个子代理，把一个项目从先例调研一路带到会议汇报 PPT、学术海报与社媒笔记卡片——Zotero 文献入库、结构化阅读笔记、按笔记的 PDF 分类高亮、论文出图、顶刊风格章节起草、LaTeX 润色、名词术语黑话审计、防御性写作审计、官方 API 引文核查、三盲对抗审稿、逐条审稿回复、换刊转投，外加可自动发布的小红书图文笔记卡片。先例调研覆盖研究级问题——工程与学术双源并查，不止论文。
